item.title: Virginia bill to boost child abuse reporting penalties advances without key hospital CEO language
item.description: A Virginia bill to strengthen child abuse reporting penalties advances, but language targeting hospital CEOs was stripped by the Senate subcommittee.

item.title: Chesterfield Parks and Recreation to host first-ever youth talent showcase
item.description: Chesterfield Parks and Rec will host its first youth talent showcase March 26 at Meadowbrook High School. Meet one of the performers, Michael Young III, who will perform to a remix of "Thriller."

item.title: Byrd Theatre organist Bob Gulledge marks 30 years playing the Mighty Wurlitzer: 'I treasure every day here'
item.description: Bob Gulledge has performed seven concerts a week at Richmond's historic Byrd Theatre for 30 years, keeping a nearly century-old tradition alive on the theater's custom-made Mighty Wurlitzer.
